checks.detail: Both primary roles receive one sampled family query; families cycle by update modulo4. Selected replay checks modality/request/count/kind/rank/tokens and exact executed box. Teacher functions receive model/batch and cannot write the tracker; state/template/history equality is asserted before optimization. Quality smooth-L1 is added to the mean of two sampled query losses, or three equally weighted query losses when selected is extra. Signed executed query-minus-primary IoU is not clamped.

These checks are sanity-only where specified and are not a completed real C M0.
